title: Multi-Agent Protocol Schema
description: JSON Schema for the Multi-Agent Protocol (MAP) - a protocol for observing, coordinating, and routing messages within multi-agent AI systems

RequestId.description: Unique identifier for a request, used to correlate responses

MAPRequest.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 request message in MAP

MAPResponse.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 response message in MAP

MAPNotification.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 notification message in MAP (no response expected)

ErrorCategory.description: Category of error for handling decisions

ParticipantId.description: Unique identifier for any participant (agent, client, system, gateway)

Meta.description: Vendor extension metadata. Implementations MUST NOT assume specific keys.

ParticipantType.description: Type of participant in the protocol

ParticipantCapabilities.description: Capabilities of a participant, grouped by category

canReceive.description: Can receive messages addressed to it

Participant.description: A participant in the MAP protocol

AgentState.description: State of an agent. Standard states are enumerated; custom states use 'x-' prefix.

Agent.description: An agent in the multi-agent system

AgentEnvironment.description: Compute environment information for an agent. Describes the runtime context where the agent executes.

HostInfo.description: Information about the host machine. Conventions follow OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for host.*.

OSInfo.description: Operating system information. Conventions follow OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for os.*.

command.description: Command used to start the process

ContainerInfo.description: Container runtime information. Present when the agent runs inside a container.

capabilities.description: Linux capabilities granted to the container

CloudInfo.description: Cloud provider information. Conventions follow OpenTelemetry semantic conventions for cloud.*.

KubernetesInfo.description: Kubernetes environment information. Present when the agent runs in a Kubernetes cluster.

FilesystemInfo.description: Filesystem and workspace information. Critical for coordinating file-based operations between agents.

mounts.description: Mount points relevant to the agent's work

ephemeral.description: Whether the filesystem is ephemeral (lost on restart)

path.description: Absolute path on this agent's filesystem

shared.description: Whether the mount is shared with other agents

sharedWith.description: IDs of agents that share this mount

available.description: Whether the integration is currently accessible

url.description: URL or path to access this integration

NetworkInfo.description: Network environment information. Describes connectivity and network topology.

hostname.description: Hostname as seen on the network

installed.description: Installed tools/executables. Key is tool name, value can be version string or object.

runtimes.description: Language runtimes available. Maps language to version(s).

canInstall.description: Whether the agent can install new tools

cpuLimit.description: CPU limit (in cores or millicores, e.g., '2', '500m')

maxExecutionSeconds.description: Maximum execution time in seconds (for serverless)

shared.description: Whether resources are shared with other workloads

ServicesInfo.description: External services and APIs the agent has access to.

aiProviders.description: AI/ML model providers (e.g., huggingface, openai, anthropic)

mcp.description: MCP servers available to this agent

ServiceAccess.description: Access information for an external service.

models.description: Specific models or resources accessible (for AI providers)

available.description: Whether the server is currently available

tools.description: Tools provided by this MCP server

resources.description: Resources provided by this MCP server

ScopeAddress.description: Address all agents in a scope

RoleAddress.description: Address agents by role, optionally within a scope

HierarchicalAddress.description: Address relative to sender in hierarchy

BroadcastAddress.description: Address all agents in the system

ParticipantAddress.description: Address any participant by ID or category

FederatedAddress.description: Address an agent in a federated system

Message.description: A message in the multi-agent system

payload.description: Message payload - structure depends on use case

ScopeVisibility.description: Who can see the scope exists and its members

MessageVisibility.description: Who can see messages sent to this scope

SendPolicy.description: Who can send messages to this scope

causedBy.description: IDs of events that caused this one (causal ordering)

roles.description: Only events from agents with these roles

replayFrom.description: Replay missed events from this point

ConnectRequest.description: Connect to the MAP system and negotiate capabilities

DisconnectRequest.description: Gracefully disconnect from the MAP system

AgentsGetRequest.description: Get details for a single agent

SendRequest.description: Send a message to an address

delivered.description: Participants the message was delivered to

AgentsRegisterRequest.description: Register a new agent in the system

AgentsSpawnRequest.description: Register agent and assign initial task atomically

AgentsUnregisterRequest.description: Remove an agent from the system

ScopesGetRequest.description: Get details for a single scope

ScopesJoinRequest.description: Add an agent to a scope

ScopesLeaveRequest.description: Remove an agent from a scope

InjectRequest.description: Inject context into a running agent (steering)

FederationConnectRequest.description: Connect to a peer MAP system

FederationRouteRequest.description: Route a message to a federated system
